There is no evidence of instability or data gaps that would compromise product quality or safety. The brand manufacturer’s patent expired six months ago, removing any legal barrier to approval. Under the applicable ANDA approval framework, this application meets all technical, regulatory, and public health criteria and warrants approval to realize the substantial cost savings for patients.
